subject: general
question: The Prime Minister of Pakistan, Imran Khan (as of October 2020), belongs to which political party?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf i**s a centrist political party in Pakistan. 
 
• It was founded in **1996 by the Pakistani cricketer-turned-politician Imran Khan**.
 
• Imran Khan is a **Pakistani politician and the former Prime Minister of Pakistan.**
 
• Before joining politics, Khan was a cricket player. He was the captain of the Pakistan national cricket team which won the 1992 Cricket World Cup.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** All-India Muslim League** was a political party established in **1906 in British India**. The party arose out of the need for the political representation of Muslims in British India, especially in the event of the Indian National Congress-sponsored massive Hindu opposition to the 1905 partition of Bengal
 
• The **Sind United Party **was a political party in Sind, British India.** The party was founded in June 1936,** the same year that the Sind province had been created. The party was modelled on the Punjab Unionist Party.
 
• Th**e Pakistan People's Party **is a centre-left, social-democratic political party in Pakistan. It is currently the **third largest party in the National Assembly**.
